description: This PHP file defines the SugarSpriteBuilder class, responsible for creating sprite images from individual image files, and SpritePlacement class for arranging sprite positions. It also includes logic for reading images, minifying CSS, and generating associated CSS and metadata files, primarily used within the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM context.

classes.name: SugarSpriteBuilder
classes.description: Handles creation of sprite images from directory of images, including support for repeatable sprites, CSS generation, and metadata management.

classes.name: SpritePlacement
classes.description: Calculates positions for sprite images within a sprite sheet based on configured placement algorithms.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the sprite builder, checking for GD library support and supported image types.

methods.name: addDirectory
methods.description: Adds a directory of images to the sprite source list.

methods.name: getFileList
methods.description: Processes the specified directory to list supported image files for sprite creation.

methods.name: loadSpritesConfig
methods.description: Loads optional sprite configuration settings from a 'sprites_config.php' file within a directory.

methods.name: getFileInfo
methods.description: Retrieves image dimensions and type if supported and within size limits.

methods.name: createSprites
methods.description: Main method to generate sprite images, associated CSS, and metadata based on added directories.

methods.name: initSpriteImg
methods.description: Initializes an empty sprite image resource with transparency.

methods.name: loadImage
methods.description: Loads an image resource from file based on the image type.

methods.name: logMessage
methods.description: Handles logging or output of messages based on class settings.
